zh-CN.title: 菜单、账号与活动展示优化
items: 长按菜单边距更均衡，活动横幅限制高度并在宽屏并排展示
切换账号先选空间，多身份再选择；加载时提供反馈
新增登录其他账号入口，WebApp 启动自动恢复上次使用的账号

en.title: Menu, account and activity improvements
items: Balanced message menu spacing and height-limited activity banners that sit side by side on wide screens
Choose a space first when switching accounts, then an identity if needed, with loading feedback
A separate sign-in entry and automatic restoration of the last account on WebApp launch
